inspection.method: read-only source inspection before authoring these two inventory documents
inspection.reasonVerificationDeferred: User requested source implementation with tests deferred.
inspection.evidenceMeaning: source_inspected means symbols, routes and documented behavior were read at the source pin; it is not a fresh execution result. source_written_unverified means source is delivered but unbuilt and uninstalled, with functionality pending exercise rather than an observed runtime result.

stageDefinitions.source_inspected: Implementation or contract exists at the pinned source; not executed during this inventory.
stageDefinitions.desktop_only_intentionally_unexposed: Existing app capability preserved; no permission or bridge endpoint exposes it to this native interface.
stageDefinitions.browser_interface_only: Native actor validates a private local link and opens the existing browser interface; it does not submit work or report job completion.
stageDefinitions.source_written_unverified: New native connection source is delivered, but unbuilt, uninstalled and not accepted; functionality is a source implementation pending exercise.
stageDefinitions.native_unbound: Existing app endpoint has no native work/result UI binding in this scope.
stageDefinitions.not_implemented: Source does not implement the proposed capability.
stageDefinitions.disabled_unverified_transport: Provider adapter exists but defaults disabled; no real provider execution is authorized or established.

protocol.authorization: Authorization: Bearer <process-capability>; X-Session-Token after session creation
protocol.origin: Exact literal-loopback Host required. Origin may be absent for native requests; if present it must equal the exact loopback origin. No CORS permission.

submit.envelope: PTP1; big-endian uint32 count; each: uint8 type(1 PNG,2 JPEG), uint32 length, exact bytes; no trailing bytes
submit.retry: identical key and bytes recover same job; changed bytes return 409

protocol.cancellation: DELETE removes access, outputs and action key; read becomes 404. Reusing the released key can create new work, so a client must not retry canceled work as an uncertain active action.
protocol.privacy: Selected bytes only; no source names/paths or client export paths on the wire; generated photo-N.pdf attachments; output PDFs contain decoded normalized pixels; no external upload.

submit.envelope: IOP1; big-endian uint32 count; uint8 quality(70..95); uint8 resize(0/1); uint32 width(1..4096); uint8 outputFormat(0 source,1 PNG,2 JPEG); each uint8 sourceType(1 PNG,2 JPEG), uint32 length, exact bytes
